articles.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
articles.description: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

articles.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
articles.description: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

articles.title: Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro imminent
articles.description: “The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments,” according to the ECB president.

articles.title: Bitget to discontinue services for some users in one-off exercise
articles.description: Bitget says user funds are safe and exchange will continue to operate during the change.
